'''Adamek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] military who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], she participated in the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon|Battle of Sebaddon]] against the witch-produced [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]]. She received orders to repair the equipment while she battled the droids.
